<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="sliding_cabinet">

  <!-- Base cabinet body -->
  <link name="cabinet_body">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.775" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.36 0.56 1.55"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="light_wood">
        <color rgba="0.8 0.7 0.5 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>

      <origin xyz="0 0 0.775" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.36 0.56 1.55"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <mass value="30.0"/>
      <!-- Inertia of a solid box: Ixx = 1/12 m (h^2 + d^2), Iyy = 1/12 m (w^2 + d^2), Izz = 1/12 m (w^2 + h^2) -->
      <inertia ixx="1.12" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="5.30" iyz="0.0"
               izz="5.30"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Left sliding door -->
  <link name="door_left">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.775" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.68 0.02 1.55"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="door_material">
        <color rgba="0.6 0.6 0.6 1"/>

      <origin xyz="0 0 0.775" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.68 0.02 1.55"/>

               iyy="0.30" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.30"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <joint name="joint_left_door" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="cabinet_body"/>
    <child link="door_left"/>
    <!-- Closed position: door centered at -0.34 m (half width) -->
    <origin xyz="-0.34 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit lower="-0.68" upper="0.0" effort="100" velocity="0.5"/>
  </joint>
